# Google Ads Developer Starter Checklist

 Stay organized with collections Save and categorize content based on your preferences.
This checklist will take you through the process to get started with the Google Ads API. The steps are divided into several categories, some of which you might decide to skip if they aren't applicable to your needs. To get the most from this document, read and execute steps in order.

The list contains three types of items:

| ![](/static/google-ads/api/images/checkbox.png) | **Todo:** Steps that are required in order to perform a certain task or set up a certain part of your tool. |
|---|---|
| | |
| | |
If you're printing the checklist, you can use the checkboxes on the left to mark which steps are completed. This checklist provides a recommended reading order for the information found in the [Google Ads API docs](/google-ads/api).

## Access and setup

| ![](/static/google-ads/api/images/checkbox.png) | [Obtain your developer token](/google-ads/api/docs/get-started/dev-token) from the API Center of your top-level manager account. All fields on the API Access form must be completed, and the Terms and Conditions accepted. Make sure the API contact email you provide leads to a regularly monitored inbox. You will be issued a developer token with the [test account access level](/google-ads/api/docs/access-levels#test_account_access). |
|---|---|
| | |
| ![](/static/google-ads/api/images/checkbox.png) | To get your token approved for production access, you'll need to fill out our [follow-up application form](//support.google.com/adspolicy/contact/new_token_application) and explain how you intend to use the API. You'll also need to provide a design document. You can use [our template](//docs.google.com/document/d/1i1xc8kChjZISoSclTAaRReDwWZQDCcYDGOUJPR8hGJM/edit) to get started. Provide as much detail as you can. Our token review team will contact you if they need more information, but you can also reach out through our [contact form](//support.google.com/adspolicy/contact/contact_ads_api) if there is no feedback within 2 business days. |
| | |
| | |

### Set up a client library

| ![](/static/google-ads/api/images/checkbox.png) | We use **OAuth 2.0** for authenticating your requests against the API. Follow the instructions in our [OAuth 2.0 guide](/google-ads/api/docs/oauth/overview) to set up the credentials for OAuth 2.0. For troubleshooting, you can use the [OAuth 2.0 playground](/google-ads/api/docs/oauth/playground). |
|---|---|
| ![](/static/google-ads/api/images/checkbox.png) | We provide [client libraries](/google-ads/api/docs/client-libs) for some common programming languages. Download the library for the language you want to use and set up its configuration file with your previously obtained credentials. |

### Developer Token - Access Levels

| ![](/static/google-ads/api/images/checkbox.png) | Read about [Access Levels](/google-ads/api/docs/access-levels), and decide whether your tool will require more than **15,000 operations per day** at some point in the future. If it will, you will need to apply for [Standard Access](/google-ads/api/docs/access-levels#standard_access) for unlimited `mutate` operations and `GoogleAdsService.Search` and `GoogleAdsService.SearchStream` requests per day. However, this is still subject to the daily limit of **1,000 get operations**. |
|---|---|
| ![](/static/google-ads/api/images/checkbox.png) | Review the [Rate Sheet](/google-ads/api/docs/rate-sheet) to understand how operations are calculated for your access level. Note, `GoogleAdsService.Search` requests with the `page_token` field set does not count towards the operations limit. |

## Automate budgets

| ![](/static/google-ads/api/images/checkbox.png) | Read about the [Payment methods and settings](//support.google.com/google-ads/topic/3119147) to understand the available billing options in Google Ads, such as automatic payments, manual payments, monthly invoicing (credit line). |
|---|---|
| | |
| ![](/static/google-ads/api/images/checkbox.png) | Check out the [Billing Setup](/google-ads/api/docs/billing/billing-setups) to understand how to manage payment profiles and payment accounts programmatically. |
| ![](/static/google-ads/api/images/checkbox.png) | Read about the [Account Budget](/google-ads/api/docs/billing/account-budgets) to understand how budgets can automatically be assigned to accounts. |
| | |
| ![](/static/google-ads/api/images/checkbox.png) | Contact your business representative at Google to apply to be enrolled for monthly billing. |
| ![](/static/google-ads/api/images/checkbox.png) | Contact your business representative at Google to apply for access to the [AccountBudgetProposalService](/google-ads/api/reference/rpc/v18/AccountBudgetProposalService) . |
| ![](/static/google-ads/api/images/checkbox.png) | Create an [AccountBudgetProposal](/google-ads/api/docs/billing/account-budgets#creating_an_account_budget_proposal) and assign it to an account. Try using the budget in conjunction with a [campaign budget](/google-ads/api/reference/rpc/v18/CampaignBudget). |

## Staying up to date

Keep your code up to date with changes in the Google Ads API.

### Versioning

| | |
|---|---|
| ![](/static/google-ads/api/images/checkbox.png) | When a new API is released, get the [latest version of our client library](/google-ads/api/docs/client-libs). |
| ![](/static/google-ads/api/images/checkbox.png) | Add a bookmark to the latest [Release Notes](/google-ads/api/docs/release-notes) and review the main changes in each version. |
| ![](/static/google-ads/api/images/checkbox.png) | Replace calls to the earlier version of the client library with calls to the new version. |
| ![](/static/google-ads/api/images/checkbox.png) | Follow this [blog](//ads-developers.googleblog.com/2019/02/subscribe-to-our-rss-feed-to-get-blog.html) to subscribe to our RSS feed to get blog posts by email, and check [the forum](//groups.google.com/g/adwords-api) to get the latest information regarding the Google Ads API. |
| ![](/static/google-ads/api/images/checkbox.png) | Make sure the API contact email registered in the [API Center](//ads.google.com/aw/apicenter) of your main manager account is up to date, as this is how we contact you if we find any technical issues related to your usage of the API. |
Ads-Related Google products
| ![](/static/google-ads/api/images/merchant-center.png) | [Google Merchant Center](//www.google.com/retail/solutions/merchant-center/) | Google Merchant Center helps you upload your store and product data to Google and make it available for Shopping ads and other Google services. |
|---|---|---|
| ![](/static/google-ads/api/images/business-profile.png) | [Business Profile](//google.com/business/) | Your Business Profile helps you reach and engage with local customers across Google Search and Maps. |
| ![](/static/google-ads/api/images/analytics.png) | [Google Analytics](//marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics/) | Google Analytics provides in-depth reporting on how people use your website. You can use Google Analytics to learn what people do after clicking your ads. |
| ![](/static/google-ads/api/images/tag-manager.png) | [Google Tag Manager](//tagmanager.google.com/) | Google Tag Manager is a tag management system (TMS) that lets you to quickly update tracking codes and related code fragments, collectively known as tags, on your website or mobile app. |
| ![](/static/google-ads/api/images/optimize.png) | [Google Optimize](//marketingplatform.google.com/about/optimize/) | Google Optimize offers A/B testing, website testing, and personalization tools for small businesses to help deliver engaging customer experiences. |
| ![](/static/google-ads/api/images/data-studio.png) | [Google Data Studio](//datastudio.google.com/) | Data Studio turns your data into informative, easy-to-read, easy-to-share, and fully customizable dashboards and reports. |

## Getting help

| ![](/static/google-ads/api/images/checkbox.png) | Add a bookmark to the [Google Ads API guides](/google-ads/api/docs/start). Most basic concepts are thoroughly explained there. |
|---|---|
| ![](/static/google-ads/api/images/checkbox.png) | Add a bookmark to the [Google Ads API reference](/google-ads/api/reference/rpc). All functionality of the API is explained in detail there. |
| ![](/static/google-ads/api/images/checkbox.png) | Add a bookmark to the [Google Ads API support page](/google-ads/api/support), which explains the main support channels. |
| ![](/static/google-ads/api/images/checkbox.png) | Check out the Google Ads Developers [YouTube channel](//www.youtube.com/@GoogleAdsDevelopers). |
| ![](/static/google-ads/api/images/checkbox.png) | Contact your business representative / partner manager at Google to set up a meeting to address more complex strategic issues related to the API. |
